description:
Lists the tender portals the notices come from (e.g. EU TED, the federal portal) with the number of notices per portal and status. Intended for requests where the user asks which portals are covered or how many notices come from a given portal. Counts use the same rules as list_tenders (open counts exclude expired deadlines). One optional parameter (include_dead).

Example user questions: "Welche Vergabeportale sind in der Suche enthalten?"; "Wie viele EU-Ausschreibungen sind verfügbar?"; "Woher kommen die Daten in der Vergabe-Suche?"

include_dead.description: Include notices with dead portal URLs in the counts.

name: list_tender_portals
title: Vergabeportale auflisten
